description: Use when the user wants a list of workers, a specific worker's profile, or workers filtered/grouped by any attribute (location, org, position, etc.)
intent_triggers: get employees in location or organization

worker_ids.use_when: User names a specific person, or wants the full profile of one known worker

organization_id.use_when: User wants workers filtered by or grouped by department, company, cost center, or business unit name
examples: workers from Global Modern Services India
list employees in the finance department
organization_id.note: Raw org names must be resolved to this ID via lookup_tables.ORG_MAP before calling the API — never pass the raw string

include_subordinate_organizations.use_when: User implies a whole org tree, not just one team — words like 'entire division', 'all under', 'including sub-teams'

country_id.use_when: User filters by country or region
country_id.note: Resolve country name to ISO code via lookup_tables.COUNTRY_MAP first

position_id.use_when: User references a specific job position/requisition, not a job title in general

national_id.use_when: User provides a legal/government ID for identity lookup — rare in casual queries, only use if explicitly given
examples: find the worker with SSN/Aadhaar number X

exclude_inactive_workers.use_when: Defaults to true (active only). Set to false when the query needs terminated/inactive workers — e.g. attrition, headcount history, 'who left'

exclude_employees.use_when: User explicitly wants only contingent/contract workers, not regular employees

exclude_contingent_workers.use_when: User explicitly wants only regular employees, not contractors

effective_from.use_when: Query has a time range or 'as of' date — required for any metric/trend query (attrition, headcount over time)

effective_through.use_when: Paired with effective_from to bound a date range

as_of_effective_date.use_when: User wants a snapshot at one specific point in time, not a range
examples: org structure as of last year

page.use_when: Internal pagination control — not derived from user query, handled by executor

count.use_when: Internal pagination control — not derived from user query, handled by executor

Include_Employment_Information.use_when: User wants job title, position, employment type, or hire/termination dates
examples: years of service, hire date, tenure, job location, office location, country

Include_Organizations.use_when: User wants cost center, department, company name, business unit, or supervisory org
examples: workers in the finance cost center
cost center, department, company name, business unit, supervisory organization

Include_Compensation.use_when: User asks about salary, pay rate, compensation plan
examples: fetch worker wage, payroll, or grade info

Include_Personal_Information.use_when: User wants legal name, birth date, contact info, address
examples: gender, male, female, sex, date of birth, age, dob

Include_Career.use_when: User wants work history, previous roles, additional jobs
examples: get additional jobs or employee contract data

Include_Qualifications.use_when: User wants certifications, education, skills, languages
examples: does he have a PMP certification

Include_Benefit_Enrollments.use_when: User asks about health insurance, benefits, plan enrollment
examples: what health plan is she enrolled in
get worker benefit enrollments and eligibility

Include_Employee_Review.use_when: User wants performance reviews, manager feedback, talent assessments

known_gap: Management level (director/manager/VP) is not confirmed as a top-level field or response-group in this catalog. Likely nested inside Include_Employment_Information's Worker_Job_Data in the raw XML — must verify against a live payload before entity_resolver.py can map 'director'/'manager' to a real filter value.

description: Use to hire or onboard a new employee into an organization, establishing their position and initial compensation details.
intent_triggers: add a new worker to the organization
onboard a candidate into a position

first_name.use_when: First name of the hire candidate

last_name.use_when: Last name of the hire candidate

middle_name.use_when: Middle name of the hire candidate

organization_id.use_when: The supervisory organization ID where the employee will be placed

position_id.use_when: Specific job position ID to place them in

job_requisition_id.use_when: Requisition ID related to the hiring event

existing_worker_type.use_when: If the hire is an existing worker type transition

existing_worker_id.use_when: The ID of the existing worker if transferring

comment.use_when: Comments for the hiring business process

auto_complete.use_when: Set true to automatically complete the hiring BP if allowed by workflow
